This private CLI fixture checks coordinator ownership. It does not measure model
conversion or quantization performance; those have separate real checkpoint proofs.

Run `first.py` through ordinary `cozy run ... --rental-only`. Once the actual
executor creates `waiting`, preparation A has completed and B is waiting at a
test-only barrier. Stop the laptop controller or its observer, then release the
barrier on the owned test container. Both `continued` and `finished` must appear
without the laptop controller, and the remote root must finish with51.

Reconnect, restart only the remote Creator coordinator under the same accepted
grant, and run `edited.py` as a new ordinary script. It must finish with60; its
prepare child must reuse the original completed result with ordinal0, and the
qualification-only `prepare-count` file must still contain one line.

Observe-only timeout and Ctrl-C must detach. Explicit pause/cancel are separate
controls and must preserve their normal retained-work behavior. A lost submit
reply must reconcile the same signed capsule and stable root ID. These are proof
requirements, not a claim that this fixture has already passed.
